## Elevation

```{r}
#| label: setup-elevation
#| include: false
if (file.exists("_quarto.yml")) here::i_am("tasks/elevation/charts/index.qmd")
if (!exists("aoi")) {
  USE_GCS <<- FALSE
  source(here::here("core/R/setup.R"))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: data-loading-elevation
#| include: false
elevation <- tryCatch({
  read_csv(str_subset(list.files(tabular_dir, full = T), "elevation.csv"), col_types = "cd") %>%
    rename(Bin = 1, Count = 2) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Bin), Count > 0) %>%
    mutate(percent = Count / sum(Count),
           Bin = factor(Bin, levels = Bin))
}, error = function(e) { message("elevation not available: ", e$message); NULL })
```

```{r}
#| label: elevation-donut
#| results: asis

if (is.null(elevation) || nrow(elevation) == 0) print_text(paste_bold("No Elevation file available")) else {

  elevation_names <- elevation$Bin
  elevation_colors <- c(
    "#F2D7D3",
    "#DCBAC5",
    "#C59FB8",
    "#AF84A9",
    "#97679C") %>%
    setNames(elevation_names)

  elevation_plot <- ggdonut(elevation, "Bin", "percent", colors = elevation_colors)

  ggsave(here("03-render-output", "plots", "wsf-elevation-pieplot.png"), device = "png",
        width = 8, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = "print")
  print(elevation_plot)
  cat("\n\n")

  print_paged_df(elevation)
}
```
